feeds.title: Garden Lovers Club
feeds.description: Garden Lovers Club is a community of people who simply LOVE to garden! If you are looking for garden ideas or plant information, we have you covered! Whether you are just starting out or an experienced gardener, we have tons of ideas and info that will help you out.

feeds.title: Green Gardening Matters
feeds.description: I am Ginny - a botanist and a garden writer. I've written 100s of articles, 4 peer-reviewed books on Florida gardening, and co-authored 'Climate-Wise Landscaping.'

feeds.title: Native Florida Wildflowers
feeds.description: This is a blog that celebrates the beauty and diversity of Florida's wildflowers - with a bit of a focus on growing these plants in a home landscape.

feeds.title: South Florida Gardening
feeds.description: We are a small group of South Floridians who share a love of organic gardening, cooking, and leading a healthy lifestyle. We garden together in Miami on a weekly basis year-round and enjoy the labor, harvest, and feeling of community that this provides us.

feeds.title: VegHeadz
feeds.description: A blog about resilient and sustainable gardening of vegetables and other edibles in North Florida. VegHeadz is a group of volunteer Master Gardeners who maintain the demonstration vegetable garden at the Leon County UF/IFAS extension in Tallahassee, FL.

feeds.title: Florida Gardenista Blog
feeds.description: I am Kristy. I'm from five generations of Florida farmers and my garden currently resides in zone 9b. My hope is that this blog will bring you answers, awesome ideas and help your garden flourish!

feeds.title: FloridaGardener.com
feeds.description: Proudly serving up trustworthy Florida gardening advice since 1999.

feeds.title: Fl Gardening
feeds.description: My name is Josh and I love to garden. I was born in Tampa and have never left Florida. Unluckily for plants, I really enjoy growing them. I've grown a few plants over the years. I've also killed a few plants over the years, more than I would like to admit. I just want to share my experience and hope that it helps others.

feeds.title: VerdeGo Blog
feeds.description: VerdeGo is your premier Garden Center! Not only do we have the largest plant selection in NE Florida, but we also specialize in: Specimen Palms & Trees, Landscape Design & Installation, Maintenance, Pavers, Retaining Walls, Firepits, Water Features, Pergolas, Irrigation Systems, Exterior Lighting & more!

feeds.title: Florida Garden Supplies Blog
feeds.description: Grow it your way. Florida Garden Supplies is one of the biggest suppliers of gardening indoor in the state of Florida and currently expanding across the United States.

feeds.title: DragonFly Garden
feeds.description: I am Rusty Silverio. The blog is a journal about my urban garden and the critters that live and visit it.

feeds.title: The Consummate Gardener
feeds.description: I am Deborah. I have been gardening since I was a pre-schooler, and finally completed my AS in horticulture/greenhouse production at the age of 32. I have been working in the industry and sharing my knowledge, both online and off, before and since.

feeds.title: Florida Gardener Blog
feeds.description: I caught the gardening bug in the 80s. It started with orchids and hibiscus but quickly grew to include lawns (because I now have one), pruning shrubs, organic control of pests, and finally, vegetable gardening.
